chapterInfo.content:
11
Sofar asɛnka a ɛdi kan. Ɛsɛ Hiob sɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho ase Nyankopɔn anim
1Ɛnna Naamani Sofar gyee so sɛ:
2Wɔremmua nsɛm dodoɔ yi,
anaasɛ wɔmma ɔbarima tɛkyerɛmakyene nni bem anaa?
3Wo kasa worɔworɔ bɛma nnipa amua wɔn ano anaa?
Na sɛ wodi fɛw a, obi renhyɛ wo aniwuo anaa?
4 # Hiob 9.21; 10.7 Na woaka sɛ: Me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ gyenegyene,
na me ho te wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
5 # Hiob 38.1 O, anka ma Onyankopɔn nkasa
na ɔmmue n’ano nkyerɛ wo;
6 # Dwom 51.6 na ɔnka wo nyansa ahuntasɛm, sɛ emu dɔ yie,
na hunu sɛ Onyankopɔn yi n’ani firi w’amumuyɛ no bi so.
7Wobɛhwehwɛ ahunu Onyankopɔn
anaasɛ wobɛhunu akɔduru Otumfoɔ pɛyɛ mu anaa?
8Ɛkorɔn sɛ ɔsoro, — ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ?
Ɛyɛ kuronkuron sɛ Asamando, — ɛdeɛn na wonim?
9Ne nsusuiɛ ware sene asase,
na ɛtrɛ sene ɛpo.
10Sɛ ɔtwam ba na ɔde nnipa gu nnua mu na ɔhyia asennie a,
ɛnneɛ hwan na ɔbɛsianka no?
11Na ɔno na ɔnim nnipa ahuhufoɔ,
na ɔhunu abusudeɛ, nanso ɔmmu.
12Na onipa tibɔnkɔso nya nyansa akoma a,
na ɛte sɛdeɛ wɔawo afunumu ba onipa.
13Sɛ wo deɛ, wosiesie w’akoma,
na wotrɛ wo nsam kyerɛ no a,
14sɛ amumuyɛ wɔ wo nsam a, yi kɔ akyiri,
na mma abusudeɛ nntena wo ntomadan mu.
15Ɛno na wobɛma w’ani so a wonni dɛm,
na wobɛtim pintinn a worensuro.
16Na wo werɛ bɛfiri wo haw,
wobɛkae no sɛ nsuo a asene.
17Na wo nkwa nna bɛyɛ sɛ awia ketee,
esum bɛdane sɛ adekyeeɛ.
18Na wobɛnya abotɔyam sɛ anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ,
na wobɛhwɛ wo ho ahyia na woada dwoodwoo.
19 # Dwom 3.5; 4.8 Wobɛda ahome, na obi renyi wo hu,
na nnipa bebree bɛhwehwɛ wo hɔ adom.
20 # Hiob 8.13 Na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔn ani so bɛsi
na dwanekɔbea abɔ wɔn,
na wɔn anidasoɔ bɛdane wɔn wuo.

Wɔremmua nsɛm dodoɔ yi,

na ɔnka wo nyansa ahuntasɛm, sɛ emu dɔ yie,

Wobɛhwehwɛ ahunu Onyankopɔn

Sɛ wo deɛ, wosiesie w’akoma,

Na wobɛnya abotɔyam sɛ anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ,

Wobɛda ahome, na obi renyi wo hu,
na nnipa bebree bɛhwehwɛ wo hɔ adom.
Na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔn ani so bɛsi
na dwanekɔbea abɔ wɔn,
na wɔn anidasoɔ bɛdane wɔn wuo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
